heading: Mobile medical van launch
intro:
**Peninsula Community Health Services (PCHS)** will provide care through a mobile van twice a month once fundraising targets are met.
The van will be staffed by a PCHS primary care provider accepting new patients **RIGHT NOW!**

graphic.alt: Illustration of the PCHS mobile medical van

cards.body: After exploring multiple options, a mobile clinic is the most practical and cost-effective way to begin care on the island.
PCHS is under contract with AIHA to staff and operate the mobile van. They are a federally qualified health center with deep experience serving rural communities.
Provider visits, physical exams, lab draws, and more. Established patients receive 24/7 access to PCHS' provider-staffed phone line.
Services started on 9/21/2026 and will continue with twice-monthly visits on the 2nd and 4th Mondays. This schedule may change after the start of 2027.
